verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product, but the evidence pack has no documentation of retention settings, data purge, account or organization deletion, or deletion guarantees. The only deletion mention is bulk deleting bank rules, which is an adjacent record operation, not control over data retention. The generic API-parity claim does not establish this capability either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
